units: Design-weighted area–time support fraction, plotted as percent; distinct from attribution effect sizes.
caption: Design-weighted area–time support for the identical eight-setting comparison, by climate model. Blue segments show retained support; light grey completes the fixed requested population to 100%. Labels give retained percentages. The denominator retains original design weights and differs from the unweighted count of pairs. Model-specific support qualifies the attribution contrasts.
